messages.text: BL-1779 🎵 in progress — A project root whose own swarm-identity declares no swarm name (every test fixture root) never reads a fleet creds file and never writes the primary-root record - under the host's real HOME it used to resolve the primary's bot token and bridge port, so a fixture front desk polled the human's bot and freed the live bridge's port - and the five step handlers that start a fixture front desk give it a fleet home of its own
